title: A Graph Signal Processing Perspective on Numerical Sequence Representations in LLM In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.03015v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated in-context learning (ICL) capabilities for numerical inference over sequences serialized as text. Prior work has identified and characterized this form of numerical inference primarily through output-level evaluations such as prediction error. However, how numerical information is organized within LLM representations remains much less understood. To study this internal organization, we adopt a graph signal processing perspective in which attention induces a weighted graph over tokens, while token hidden states define signals on its nodes. Quantitative graph-spectral diagnostics and qualitative token-graph visualizations reveal that representations become more clearly differentiated by input dynamical complexity as context length increases. translated_title: 从图信号处理视角看大语言模型上下文学习中的数值序列表示
translated_abstract: 预训练大语言模型已在数值推理上展现出上下文学习能力，即能够对序列化为文本的数值序列进行推理。先前的工作主要通过预测误差等输出层面的评估来识别和刻画这种数值推理能力。然而，数值信息在大语言模型内部表示中如何组织仍知之甚少。为了研究这种内部组织结构，我们采用了图信号处理的视角：注意力机制在token之间诱导出一个加权图，而token的隐藏状态则构成该图节点上的信号。定量的图谱诊断与定性的token图可视化共同揭示出：随着上下文长度的增加，模型表示会依据输入的动力学复杂度而变得更加清晰地分化。较简单的输入所产生的注意力诱导token图具有更强的全局连通性，其隐藏状态信号也更平滑、谱能量更加集中……
tldr: 本文提出用图信号处理视角研究大语言模型上下文学习中数值信息的内部组织，将注意力视为token加权图、隐藏状态视为图上信号，发现随着上下文变长，表示按输入动力学复杂度分化：简单输入对应更强的全局连通性和更平滑、谱更集中的隐藏状态信号。
en_tdlr: This paper adopts a graph signal processing perspective—treating attention as a weighted token graph and hidden states as node signals—to reveal that LLM in-context representations become increasingly differentiated by input dynamical complexity as context grows, with simpler inputs yielding more globally connected graphs and smoother, spectrally concentrated signals.
